brief:
Several citizens sustained injuries Monday during a family altercation that involved gunfire in the Katiba area west of Gaza City, according to the General Police Directorate. The incident occurred in the western sector of the densely populated enclave.

Police said field teams were mobilized and taking action at the scene, the Shehab Wire reported. The directorate did not immediately specify the number of injured or their conditions.
